name: Article 18, § 2 – 202
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council harmonising certain aspects of insolvency law
part_text: 2. With respect to access to the national registers and databases listed in the Annex, a Member State may refuse such access to insolvency practitioners appointed in another Member State where that other Member State does not ensure a comparable level of education and continuing professional training for its insolvency practitioners, in particular in relation to the handling of personal data and commercially sensitive information. In such cases, the Member State applying higher professional standards may designate a national insolvency practitioner to act on behalf of the requesting insolvency practitioner from the Member State where lower professional standards apply.
